error.forbidden: You do not have access to this
error.previewStale: In this preview, the saved sample data may come from an older version of the app.
error.notImplemented: This part is not available in this version yet.

moduleOff.title: {{name}} module is off
moduleOff.body: Existing data is kept. Turn the module on to get new data here.

core.name: Core
core.summary: Interface, sign-in, configuration, scheduler, audit log, updates.

feeds.name: Vulnerability feeds
feeds.summary: Pulls signed data, hot board, CVE and bad IP/domain lookup.

inventory.name: Inventory
inventory.summary: Device list from manual entries and sensors, matched against vulnerabilities.

notify.name: Notifications
notify.summary: Sends alerts via Telegram, Zalo, email, webhook.

sensor-passive.name: Passive sensor
sensor-passive.summary: Listens to DHCP, mDNS, SSDP, ARP, LLDP to learn devices without scanning.

sensor-active.name: Active sensor
sensor-active.summary: Light nmap scans inside the allowed time window.

findings.name: Findings
findings.summary: Matches your devices against exploited vulnerabilities and tracks each one until it is fixed.

mitigation.name: Mitigation
mitigation.summary: Patch steps, temporary fixes and config snippets that confirmed recommendations add to a finding.

exposure.name: External surface
exposure.summary: Domains, IPs, ports and admin panels exposed to the Internet.

scan.name: Vulnerability scan
scan.summary: Safe confirmation scans; re-scans when a new exploited vulnerability appears.

scan-credentialed.name: Credentialed scan
scan-credentialed.summary: Deep scans of key servers using SSH credentials.

honeypot.name: Internal traps
honeypot.summary: Fake servers on your network; any touch raises an alert.

logs.name: Logs
logs.summary: Receives firewall and server logs; shows what is new or spiking.

agent-intake.name: Agent intake
agent-intake.summary: Receives the software list of your servers from osquery agents or Wazuh.

ai.name: AI assistant
ai.summary: Uses your own AI key to explain, write configs, read logs.

reports.name: Reports
reports.summary: Weekly report and data-protection security assessment.

mcp-server.name: MCP server
mcp-server.summary: Lets external AI tools query data, read-only.

auth-oidc.name: SSO sign-in
auth-oidc.summary: Sign in via OIDC (Keycloak, Entra ID…) with roles.

response.name: AI response
response.summary: AI proposes what to do about critical findings. Letting it carry out approved actions is a separate high-risk switch, off by default.

login.subtitle: Sign in to see exploited vulnerabilities that match your devices.
login.demoHint: Sample-data build: sign in as admin@acme.example, it@acme.example or director@acme.example with the password vedette-demo.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The link may have changed. Use the sidebar to find the page you need.

routeError.title: This page hit an error
routeError.body: Reload the page. If it keeps failing, send the text below to your administrator.
